title: Reolink Camera Offline Hotspot
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reolink:event event=camera_status
| stats count(eval(status="offline")) as offline_events by camera
| where offline_events>0
| sort - offline_events
description: Uses Reolink camera health telemetry to monitor which cameras keep going offline in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for weak cameras before coverage gaps become obvious, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Reolink camera health data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which cameras keep going offline so you can spot weak cameras before coverage gaps become obvious before it becomes annoying.
